$comment: Captured 2026-09-19 from the live WordPress/WooCommerce page. Fixture is the official HTML as captured (nav, footer, scripts retained). The Information Guide PDF is linked and is not fetched or parsed.
Prompt 9B-B grain: one session per stated date window. The page lists 8 labelled weeks; Week 1 is two discontinuous windows, so gold is 9 windows / 9 offerings.
The official page states month/day windows only — ISO dates stay null. Footer copyright 2026, PDF href 2026, and wp-content years are not a camp year.
KNOWN LIMITATION: the same month/day window in a later year, still without a stated year, collides on identity and can look unchanged.
Grades 1–6 stay grades. ageMin/ageMax stay null.
Prices are literal $360 / $450 per child. Currency stays unknown: the HTML does not state CAD, and the generic `$`→CAD assumption is not adopted.
SOLD OUT maps to seatAvailability=confirmed_full and does not close registrationStatus.
Capacity 16 is an enrolment cap on policies/provenance — CampSession has no numeric capacity field.
Price is a semantic fact, not session identity.
Regenerate via scripts/rebuild-riverwood-expected.ts — never edit to make a failing extractor pass.

gradeEligibility.copy: Riverwood is abundant with plant life and wildlife in summer, making it the perfect time for kids to explore the park and learn about the natural world – under the guidance of our experienced nature educators, of course. Children who have completed Grade 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6 can spend a week adventuring with other like-minded youth to create memories and deepen their connection to the local environment and the wider world of nature.

policies.latePickupFeeCopy: PLEASE NOTE: We will not provide pre- or post-camp care. If parents are late picking up their child(ren), an additional fee of $5 will be charged for every five minutes up to 30 minutes, and $10 for every five minutes thereafter.
policies.camperToStaffRatioCopy: Campers’ well-being is supported by a 6:1 camper to staff ratio that allows kids to go at their own pace. Our approach encourages growth in children’s well-being, confidence, creativity and love of nature. We are intentional about building an inclusive and supportive camp community.
